subject: Orchid AI launch checklist: milestone owners, dates, and next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Petrov <sasha@orchid.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + kickoff timing (first pass)

Hi Sasha —

Great to take the demo with you and Jordan this morning. As promised, attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (Orchid_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx) that breaks the onboarding into four workstreams: Security & Compliance, Data & Ingest, Integration & Testing, and Ops & Runbook.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the primary technical owner for data ingestion (we discussed Jordan but please confirm).
- Procurement: who will own the contract review and PO?
- Target go-live window: you mentioned early June — can you confirm the hard constraints?

Proposed milestone highlights (draft):
1) Security review sign-off (SOC2 docs + gap items) — target week of Apr 30
2) Data ingestion completion (s3 + streaming) — target week of May 14
3) Integration QA and perf gates (latency/regression tests) — target week of May 28
4) Production cutover & smoke (canary) — target Jun 04

If that aligns, I’ll convert the spreadsheet into a shared timeline and assign owners. Marissa, Ben — please review the milestone owners in column D and comment by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Orchid_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx
From: Sasha Petrov <sasha@orchid.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@orchid.ai>, procurement <procurement@orchid.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + kickoff timing (first pass)

Thanks Logan — this looks good and thorough. Quick answers:
- Primary tech owner: Jordan Lee (cc’d) will lead data ingestion and API work.
- Procurement contact: procurement@orchid.ai (cc’d) will handle the PO and contract redlines.
- Go-live constraints: we have a board demo scheduled Jun 10. Ideally we’re in production by Jun 04 to allow two full business days of smoke testing.

A couple of notes on the MAP:
- For Security we’ll need the SOC2 extract and an engineer-readable list of any customer-facing telemetry we collect. Can you provide the SOC2-Extract.pdf?
- For Integration: we’ll require a staging instance with an API key and a small sample export from our side (s3 path) by May 7.

Jordan — can you confirm your availability for a data kickoff on Monday (Apr 23) at 10am PT?

Best,
Sasha
Head of Product | Orchid AI
Sasha Petrov

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-18T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP + kickoff timing (first pass) — internal owners + asks

Team — forwarding Sasha’s responses. Action items:
- Marissa: lead CS kickoff and own the go-live checklist. Draft the CS readiness checklist and share by Apr 20 COB.
- Ben: coordinate staging instance creation, API key, and make sure perf testing harness is available by May 21.
- Karthik: procurement and legal touchpoint — please review the quote and DocuSign PDF, flag any standard exceptions. I’ll attach the docusign once we get it back.

I’ll schedule the Apr 23 10am PT data kickoff with Jordan and block a 30m slot.

Quick note: include the SOC2-Extract.pdf we maintain and a brief runbook stub for canary rollback in the shared Drive.

— Logan

Hi all —

Thanks for the kickoff today. Quick notes and commitments from Orchid:
- I will create the sample export (s3://orchid-staging/rdw-samples/ingest-20280423) and share IAM instructions by EOD Apr 24.
- We’ll provide the provenance metadata mapping (CSV) by May 3 to help Redwood’s ingestion validation.
- Procurement expects a final DocuSign by Apr 26 so they can issue a PO the week of Apr 29.

Two questions for Redwood:
1) For the perf gate, what is our latency SLO for the initial integration (p50 / p95 targets)?
2) Can Redwood provide a short checklist for what constitutes “integration QA sign-off”?

Jordan
Lead Data Engineer | Orchid AI

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sasha Petrov <sasha@orchid.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@orchid.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-20T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orchid AI launch checklist: milestone owners, dates, and next steps

Hi Sasha / Jordan —

Sharing the integration QA checklist and our initial perf targets below (also uploaded to the shared Drive link). I kept this tight to avoid back-and-forth: please confirm acceptance or flag concerns.

Integration QA checklist (summary):
- Data validation: sample import completes with <0.5% schema errors across 10k rows.
- Auth & connectivity: staging API key works, sample queries return expected schema.
- Functional tests: top-10 user flows pass end-to-end in staging.
- Canary gating: canary traffic routed to Redwood instance at 5% for 48 hours with automated error alerting.

Perf SLOs (initial):
- p50 generation latency: <160ms
- p95 generation latency: <450ms
- Token throughput: supports 300 rps sustained for 5m in staging under sample load

Next steps from Redwood (owners / dates):
- Ben: provision staging and perf harness — target May 5 (done)
- Logan: deliver SOC2 extract and canary rollback runbook — target Apr 24 (attached SOC2-Extract.pdf)
- Marissa: CS readiness checklist and go/no-go agenda for Jun 02 — target Apr 20
- Karthik: confirm DocuSign flow and approve standard commercial terms — target Apr 26

I’ll attach the checklists and the Docusign quote to the HubSpot deal once Karthik greenlights.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2-Extract.pdf; Docusign-Quote-OrchidAI-0424.pdf
